verdict.rationale: Intel documents a dedicated developer toolchain (oneAPI, VTune Profiler, OpenVINO, oneDNN/PyTorch optimizations) explicitly targeting Core Ultra Series 2 CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, showing official optimization guidance and tooling investment [intel-core-ultra-7-258v-docs-10][intel-core-ultra-7-258v-docs-11][intel-core-ultra-7-258v-docs-24][intel-core-ultra-7-258v-docs-25]. However, this is all first-party vendor material with no independent evidence of compiler maturity (e.g. GCC/LLVM tier-1 status), OS-level tier-one classification, or third-party developer testimonials confirming ecosystem parity. Missing for 10: independent compiler/OS tooling corroboration, third-party developer reports, comparison to competing architectures' tooling maturity.
